results.problem: z-normalized pan matrix profile (PMP) motif discovery
results.quote: Per sample, each anchor spends _O(K_) on the sliding state, _O(BK_) on the signature, and at most _R_ candidate inspections. If a fraction \(\varphi\) of inspected candidates reaches exact evaluation, the online work is \(O\big(n|A|\big(BK+R(K+\varphi m)\big)\big)\) for \(|A|=\lceil L/s\rceil\).

results.problem: z-normalized pan matrix profile (PMP) motif discovery
results.quote: Memory is _O(n|A_|(_K+B_)+_nL+n_), covering the cached features, signatures and hash metadata, profile rows, and retained raw samples.

results.problem: z-normalized pan matrix profile (PMP) motif discovery
results.bound: O(n(\log n + wm)) for the emit stage; total runtime near-linear in n
results.quote: For a fixed length interval and configuration, the online work is linear in _n_ and the emit stage is bounded by _O(n_(log_n_+wm_)), so the total runtime is near-linear in the series length.

results.problem: z-normalized pan matrix profile (PMP) motif discovery
results.bound: P_m^\mathcal{S}[i] \ge P_m[i] for every cell (sound upper pan-profile)
results.quote: Proposition 1 (Soundness). _For every_ \(\mathcal{S}\subseteq\mathcal{U}\)_, the induced profile is a sound upper pan-profile: every finite cell equals the exact z- normalized distance to the valid neighbor it stores, and_ \(P_m^\mathcal{S}[i]\ge P_m[i]\) _for every cell._
